svg.text: Attempt #9: the plaza in its materials
4.5 m to the radius; site 46 m across
Grid: 1 m, every fifth line darker,
Only what would be built is drawn: the
construction pattern of the floor is left off,
so the sheet can be drawn over by hand.
pillar on a gold line, on a glass slot
bronze stud: clock point, gate threshold
gold result lines: π west, the arc north
gold squares of the circle's area
the doubled cubes, under and over
